summary: Passionate, creative educator with over 8 years of experience in bilingual elementary classrooms. Skilled in designing engaging, standards-aligned instruction and fostering positive, inclusive learning environments.

experience.title: Bilingual Elementary Teacher
bullets: Designed and delivered bilingual instruction across all content areas, achieving 90-100% passing rates each year.
Served as a consultant for a Spanish reading program, supporting literacy development.
Led school-wide initiatives including behavior support, robotics camp, and vertical alignment teams.
Presented at regional conferences on behavior support and student engagement.
Launched and coordinated an annual talent show celebrating student creativity and school community.

experience.title: Kindergarten Bilingual Teacher
bullets: Managed a self-contained kindergarten bilingual classroom and a team-taught classroom.
Served as a cultural liaison and board member for the school's parent-teacher association.
